why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «09241»: church-month 09 = May, day 24, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate's title carries the by-name — «Симеон Дивногорец», Symeon of the Wonderful Mountain — which is this folder's own Russian form exactly, so no other Symeon can be meant. The day's only other plate is «Никита».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «11093»: church-month 11 = July, day 9, this folder's Russian and Serbian feast. The plate is titled «Феодор»; the Russian Lives keep one Theodore on 9 July, «Свт. Феодора, еп. Едесского», the bishop of Edessa, which is this folder's Russian form «Феодор Едесский» and its `bishop` type. The day's other plates are «Патермуфий и Коприй» and «Панкратий».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «09292»: church-month 09 = May, day 29, this folder's feast in all three calendars that keep her. The series draws TWO Theodosias on that day and distinguishes them by by-name: «09291 Феодосия Тирская», of Tyre, and this one, «Феодосия Константинопольская», of Constantinople — which is this folder's own Russian form exactly. The Tyrian plate is explicitly not taken.

file: File:Жития Святых (1903-1911) - икона 11232 Трофим и Феофил.png
why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «11232»: church-month 11 = July, day 23, this folder's Russian, Romanian and Serbian feast. The plate's title is «Трофим и Феофил», Trophimus and Theophilus, and this folder is that Theophilus: slug and display name «Theophilus, companion of Trophimus», Russian form «Феофил Ликийский», martyred with Trophimus in Lycia. A two-figure plate naming both, so the hero shows the pair the folder is half of. The day's other plate is «Аполлинарий».

why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «09031»: church-month 09 = May, day 3, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate's title is «Тимофей и Мавра», Timothy and Maura, and this folder is that Timothy: slug and display name «Timothy, husband of Maura», Russian form «Тимофей Фиваидский», the reader of the Thebaid martyred with his wife. A two-figure plate naming both. The day's other plate is «Феодосий».

Russian Menaion Reader plate «07201»: church-month 07 = March, day 20, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The series draws exactly three plates for that day — «Иоанн», «Сергий», «Патрикий» — and those three names in that order are this folder's own Russian name form, «Иоанн, Сергий, Патрикий и прочие в обители святого Саввы убиенные», the martyrs slain in the lavra of Saint Sabbas in 796. So the plate is of one of the folder's own named martyrs, John, and not of any other John: the day carries nobody else. STATED PLAINLY because the folder is a group and the plate is one man — the hero will show John alone, not the company.
